title: FiduciaHandoffs
description: Atomic ownership handoff payloads: transfer responsibility for a resource from one holder to another with no moment of dual or zero ownership. On accept the new owner receives a strictly higher fencing token.

HandoffOfferRequest.title: HandoffOfferRequest
HandoffOfferRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/handoffs/offer. The original owner keeps authority until the offer is accepted.

resource.description: The resource whose ownership is being transferred.

to.description: Recipient the resource is offered to.

from_token.description: The current owner's fencing token, proving ownership.

context.description: Context manifest handed to the recipient.

ttl_ms.description: Accept deadline in ms. Defaults to 30000.

HandoffDecisionRequest.title: HandoffDecisionRequest
HandoffDecisionRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/handoffs/accept and /v1/handoffs/reject. Only the offered recipient may decide.

to.description: The offered recipient making the decision.

HandoffState.title: HandoffState
HandoffState.description: Current handoff state returned by GET /v1/handoffs.

to_token.description: Recipient's fencing token, minted on accept (strictly higher than from_token).
